excerpt: Sentry runs alongside your agent loop to detect failures, guide recovery, and learn reusable lessons from verified recoveries. Quick Start | Paper (arXiv) | License Sentry is an external runtime failure management layer for LLM agents. It helps agents fix invalid actions and recover when they get stuck in loops, drift from the task, or make unsupported assumptions. Unlike typical runtime monitors with fixed advice, Sentry learns and evolves from recoveries that work. By detecting failures, guiding recovery, and checking that the repair worked, Sentry helps agents become more reliable across tasks without cluttering their context. Results reported in the paper: - 37% average relative improvement over the strongest runtime-intervention baseline across WebShop, AppWorld, SWE-bench Lite, and Mind2Web Replay. - 39% average relative improvement over the strongest context-evolution baseline on held-out WebShop and Mind2Web Replay tasks. - 1.54× base-agent token usage, versus 2.44× for AgentForesight. - Lower average task latency than the base agent on SWE-bench Lite (31.7s saved) and AppWorld (45.6s saved). - 81.7% recovery rate across 939 detected failures. Sentry requires Python 3.10 or later. git clone cd Sentry python -m venv .venv source .venv/bin/activate python -m pip install -e . Copy the OpenAI configuration template, then set your model ID: mkdir -p outputs cp configs/providers/openai.yaml outputs/sentry.yaml export OPENAI_API_KEY="your-api-key" In outputs/sentry.yaml, replace YOUR_DEPLOYMENT_MODEL_ID with the exact model ID available to your account. Then validate the configuration: sentry-validate outputs/sentry.yaml Validation prints the resolved configuration as JSON without making a model request. For other providers or a local endpoint, see Model providers. Run this Python example from the repository root.
